end.parentNote: Asha practised making 10 with fingers and a bead slider. Gauri used counting to identify pairs such as 4 and 6 and 7 and 3, but continued to say that only 5 and 5 makes 10; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, try showing two groups of objects and rearranging them to make 10 in different ways, such as 1+9, 2+8, and 5+5.
